form.label: Notable Agentic Enrichment
form.description: Structured data collected by either notable_to_perplexity_json.py (Perplexity agentic response, delivery_method="perplexity_api") or notable_to_slack_json.py (Slack notification, delivery_method="file_upload"/"webhook") for a specific Adaptive Response invocation - both actions share this collection. Reached via the custom drilldown_uri on either action's entry in a notable's Adaptive Responses panel (form.sid / form.rid are passed automatically).

panel.title: Agentic response / delivery enrichment record(s) for this notable

search.query: | inputlookup notable_agentic_enrichment_lookup where sid="$sid$" AND rid="$rid$" | table event_id sent_at delivery_method slack_channel slack_permalink urgency_set hard_escalation hard_escalation_reasons status error additional_fields | sort - sent_at
| inputlookup notable_agentic_enrichment_lookup where sid="$sid$" AND rid="$rid$" | sort - sent_at | head 1 | table additional_fields | fields - _key
